lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six visible vertical columns of high-intensity circular clusters are located posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains between 3 and 7 spots, showing a relatively uniform spatial distribution forming a repeating geometric grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, running perpendicular to the carinae and intersecting with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a distinct lattice of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. These features are defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high-luminance values on the dorsal-facing edge and lower-intensity shadow values on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 8 to 12 distinct high-luminance blobs. The distribution is non-uniform, with smaller clusters appearing near the anterior margin and larger, more isolated blobs toward the center of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of small, white, linear superficial abrasions are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, localized above the area of the second and third gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral region of the animal, trailing posterior to the pectoral fin.
